SELECT SUM(oi.qty) as total_quantity 
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.launched_at >= '2026-08-01';
SELECT SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) as total_sales FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.id WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')

SELECT SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) AS sales_amount
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') 
  AND orders.order_date LIKE '2026-10%'

SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) AS cancelled_order_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) = '09' THEN qty * unit_price ELSE 0 END) as september_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) = '10' THEN qty * unit_price ELSE 0 END) as october_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2026'

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) = '09' THEN qty * unit_price ELSE 0 END) as september_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) = '10' THEN qty * unit_price ELSE 0 END) as october_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2026'

SELECT october_sales - september_sales as change
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) = '09' THEN qty * unit_price ELSE 0 END) as september_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) = '10' THEN qty * unit_price ELSE 0 END) as october_sales
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2026'
)

args.sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) * 100.0 / 
    (SELECT SUM(oi2.qty * oi2.unit_price) 
     FROM order_items oi2 
     JOIN orders o2 ON oi2.order_id = o2.id 
     WHERE o2.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')) AS percentage
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') 
AND c.parent_id = 1  -- 数码大类

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) / 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN o.id END) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id;

SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS gross_profit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1;
